# frontend-skills

> Ten model-agnostic frontend craft skills for AI coding agents — typography, color
> (OKLCH), dark mode, responsive layout, component states, forms, empty/loading/error
> states, motion, and WCAG 2.2 accessibility. Each is a Markdown SKILL.md an agent
> loads when relevant: named anti-patterns, real values, before/after, self-check.

Skills are plain Markdown (SKILL.md + references/ + assets/). They work with any AI
coding agent that can read files (Claude Code, Codex, Gemini CLI, Cursor, Kilocode,
Kimi). No SDK or runtime. Install via install.sh (symlinks into each agent's skills dir).

## Skills
- [web-typography](skills/web-typography/SKILL.md): type scale, measure, rhythm, fonts, fluid clamp, web-font CLS, WCAG text
- [deslop-ui](skills/deslop-ui/SKILL.md): remove AI visual tells; commit to a real direction
- [dark-mode](skills/dark-mode/SKILL.md): surfaces, elevation-by-lightness, contrast, toggle
- [color-system](skills/color-system/SKILL.md): OKLCH palettes, ramps, semantic tokens, contrast
- [responsive-layout](skills/responsive-layout/SKILL.md): mobile-first, intrinsic patterns, container queries
- [component-states](skills/component-states/SKILL.md): full interactive state matrix + ARIA
- [form-ux](skills/form-ux/SKILL.md): labels, validation, input types, accessible forms
- [empty-states](skills/empty-states/SKILL.md): empty/loading/error screens with recovery
- [micro-motion](skills/micro-motion/SKILL.md): performant tasteful animation + reduced-motion
- [a11y-pass](skills/a11y-pass/SKILL.md): runnable WCAG 2.2 AA fix pass

## Start here
- [README](README.md): what this is, why, and how to install
- [Verification report](docs/VERIFICATION.md): how every skill was tested end-to-end before release
